## Copilot Review Checklist

The following areas will be automatically reviewed by GitHub Copilot:

- [ ] **Code Quality**: Adherence to coding standards and best practices
- [ ] **Security**: Potential vulnerabilities and security concerns
- [ ] **Performance**: Optimization opportunities and performance implications

- [ ] **Kotlin/Java Best Practices**: Language-specific improvements
- [ ] **Documentation**: Code comments and documentation completeness
- [ ] **Test Coverage**: Adequate testing for new functionality
- [ ] **Maintainability**: Code readability and long-term maintainability
